review_comments.body:
issue (blocking): [P1] 保留 Messages 结构化输出的 schema 约束

这里关闭了严格校验，Chat 分支也省略了 `strict`。例如，调用方要求 `summary` 为必填字段，上游却以正常完成状态返回 `{}` 时，两个适配器都可以把它作为成功的 Messages 文本返回，依赖 schema 的客户端会在解析时失败。能映射到上游严格模式的 schema 可以启用该模式。对于其余 schema，请明确兼容策略，例如校验失败时返回协议错误，并补一个上游返回不匹配 JSON 的回归用例。

[Claude 结构化输出](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/structured-outputs) · [OpenAI Structured Outputs](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/structured-outputs)

Addressed in e419d222.

- Schemas within the strict subset (every object closed with `additionalProperties: false` and all properties required, only basic keywords) are now sent with `strict: true` to both Chat and Responses upstreams.
- Other schemas keep `strict: false`, so optional properties are still accepted.
- In every case the gateway validates a completed (`end_turn`) reply against the schema. On mismatch a non-streaming request gets a 502 `api_error`. A streaming request has already received the text deltas, so it ends with an `error` event instead of `message_delta`/`message_stop`.
- Truncated, refused and tool-call turns are not validated; their stop reason is reported as before.
- A schema that cannot be compiled (for example with a remote `$ref`) is rejected with a 400.

Regression cases cover an upstream returning `{}` or non-JSON, for both adapters, streaming and non-streaming. `github.com/google/jsonschema-go` moves from an indirect to a direct dependency.


This comment was drafted with Claude Code.
